vector_memory.semantic_summary: StreamOrchestrator manages the entire lifecycle of a token stream received from an AI model. It is responsible for sanitizing raw tokens, routing them through handlers (UI display or tool execution), and accumulating the final text output. It acts as a critical service layer, interfacing with SpeechBridge and OutputPrinter to manage user interaction and state tracking, including interruption handling.
